notCovered.zai image success path: The route guards the provider URL with a hostname allowlist (.z.ai / .ufileos.com) and then fetches it AS GIVEN. The pinned side could answer a .z.ai URL from the controlled peer, but the GO replay cannot: the guard is evaluated by the implementation, and no local listener can answer to a .z.ai name. Recording it would put a scenario in the fixture that the Go replay can never drive, so only the refusal and error branches are recorded, each asserting the exact request count.
notCovered.zai image 404 retry: The retry loop (5 attempts, delay(1000) between 404s, format from path.extname) is unreachable for the same reason: it needs a .z.ai URL. The retry cadence and the extname mapping are covered by LABELLED Go implementation tests instead of a fixture.
notCovered.zai video exhaustion: Thirty polls with delay(5000 + attempt*1000) is 591 seconds of wall clock, so the branch is NOT recorded and the probe does not shorten the pinned delay. A LABELLED Go implementation test asserts 30 polls and the bare 500.
notCovered.zai video unknown task_status: Any status other than FAIL/SUCCESS keeps polling to exhaustion, the same 591 seconds; not recorded. The Go loop continues, which is the pinned behaviour read from the source.
notCovered.zai video client disconnect: The abort answers "Video generation aborted by client" at the top of each iteration; the disconnect cannot be produced reliably through the probe. A LABELLED Go implementation test asserts the message and that no poll follows the disconnect.
